title: Robotic Intern
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for students looking to kick-start their careers. Please review the Job Description shared below and apply if your skills and interests align with the role. 
 Position:  Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development (Internship)
 Location:  Ahmedabad (Fx31Labs Office)
 Address:  205, Amrakunj Avis, Near Tapovan Circle, Above Gwalbhog Restaurant, Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382424 
 Job Description: Fx31Labs is seeking a passionate and hands-on Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development  to join our advanced robotics team. This internship offers a fast-paced, end-to-end engineering experience involving aerial robotics, embedded systems, autonomous navigation, perception, and real-world prototype development.This role is ideal for students and early-career engineers looking to gain practical experience in designing, building, testing, and improving autonomous robotic platforms. 
 Key Responsibilities: Design & Build Assemble and integrate motors, ESCs, sensors, flight controllers, microcontrollers, and communication modules. Design and prototype electronic systems for rapid testing and development. Assist in mechanical assembly, wiring, and hardware integration of robotic platforms. Embedded Systems & Control Develop Python and C/C++ software for sensor integration, control systems, and autonomous behaviors. Interface with hardware using UART, CAN, IC, SPI, USB, and wireless communication protocols. Implement safety mechanisms, telemetry systems, and fault-detection routines. Autonomous Navigation & Perception Integrate sensors such as IMUs, GPS, LiDAR, cameras, depth sensors, and range finders. Develop and test localization, navigation, and obstacle-avoidance capabilities. Work with computer vision and perception pipelines for environmental awareness. ROS 2 & SLAM Implement and tune SLAM and localization frameworks using ROS 2. Work with tools such as Cartographer, RTAB-Map, Nav2, and related autonomy stacks. Support mapping, path planning, and autonomous mission execution. System Integration & Testing Integrate hardware, firmware, and software into a fully functional robotic system. Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and validation across electronics, software, and mechanical subsystems. Conduct field testing and analyze system performance. Rapid Prototyping & Iteration Build, test, evaluate, and refine prototypes through iterative development cycles. Document experiments, test results, and design improvements. Contribute innovative ideas to improve system reliability and performance. Team Collaboration Collaborate closely with robotics, embedded, AI, mechanical, and software engineers. Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, testing sessions, and technical discussions. Present findings, challenges, and proposed solutions to the engineering team. 
 Qualifications: Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience with robotics, embedded systems, drones, autonomous vehicles, or related projects. Proficiency in Python and basic C/C++ programming. Understanding of sensors, control systems, communication protocols, and microcontroller-based development. Experience with hardware assembly, wiring, debugging, and soldering. Comfortable working on both software and physical hardware systems. 
 Nice-to-Haves: Experience with ROS 2 and robotic middleware. Knowledge of SLAM, localization, path planning, and autonomous navigation. Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, or similar robotics/autonomy frameworks. Familiarity with OpenCV, computer vision, or AI-based perception systems. Experience with Linux (Ubuntu) development environments. Familiarity with CAD tools such as Fusion 360, SolidWorks, or Onshape. Understanding of wireless communication systems and telemetry. 
 Soft Skills: Self-driven and highly proactive. Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities. Curious mindset with a passion for building real-world robotic systems. Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a rapid prototyping environment. Strong communication and teamwork skills. 
 Why Join Us? End-to-End Engineering Experience:   Work on complete autonomous robotic systems from design and prototyping to testing and deployment. Advanced Robotics Exposure:   Gain hands-on experience in embedded systems, aerial robotics, autonomous navigation, perception, and ROS 2-based autonomy. Learning & Mentorship:   Collaborate with experienced engineers and receive practical guidance in real-world R&D projects. Innovation-Driven Environment:   Be part of a team focused on rapid prototyping, experimentation, and cutting-edge technology development. 
 Internship Details: Duration:  3–6 Months
 Type:  Internship with mentorship, certification, and learning opportunities
 Location:  On-site at Fx31Labs, Ahmedabad 
 About Fx31Labs: Fx31Labs is an innovation-driven tech company delivering solutions at the intersection of robotics, AI, and software development. We specialize in building intelligent, scalable, and automation-first systems for startups and enterprises alike.
